gate_B7.comparison: signal-aware algo (B2 urgency / B3 pacing) vs the plain algo of the same name on the SAME windows, same policy, same size cell
gate_B7.fill_rate_condition: signal-aware fill rate not lower than plain by more than 0.02 (paired, same clustering)
gate_B7.multiplicity: Holm over the four algos; a cell passes only if both the cost and the fill-rate conditions hold
gate_B7.no_look: the fresh days are not read until this draft is signed and registered (tools/*_register.py, --require-ci-env)
report_always: depth_exhausted parent share and qty share of unfilled
gate_B7.statistic: paired per-parent difference signal-aware - plain in all_in bps, mean with day-clustered SE (one cluster per session), Student-t with G - 1 df

holdout: data/real/r7_holdout and the 2026 holdout are never read by this benchmark; the signed test runs once on the IEX fresh days and the Nasdaq/IEX overlap days (B7)
primary_metric: all_in bps per parent (shortfall + fees_net + sim_impact + completion), labelled replay + linear child adder (rule 6)

simulator.note: costs are replay + adder: simulated fills never move the replayed book; the signed run uses configs/prereg/v2.json realism opt-ins and impact_model=parent with the fitted exponent (label recorded at run time)
